scientific_question: Does an explicit teacher-forced hinge at the first TRAIN-identity unique-commit token raise native greedy exact+EOS, especially on shared-prefix DEV names, without lowering inherited T24 gates?
earned_by: T28_SUFFIX_MARGIN_VALID_COMPLETION/OUTPUT_FAIL + TOKENIZER_ASSOCIATION_SUPPORTED + EARLY_TOKEN_ERROR_CAUSALLY_DOMINATES (prefix-rescue 108/124). Tokenizer lineage remains paused. T29 is authorized by TREATMENT No29.
hypothesis: Baby often has enough downstream capacity to finish if she enters the correct token path at the first identity-disambiguating fork. Train that fork natively; do not retokenize, constrain decoding, or open TEST.

inherited_recipe.answer_ce: teacher-forced CE on correct candidate_token_ids + EOS; full span through the base (T18)
inherited_recipe.unlikelihood: inherited T24 inventory-wide unlikelihood over frozen 24 train+dev names; not the T29 hypothesis
inherited_recipe.batch: 32 QA / update, micro 8; schedules remapped from T28 85000x onto 86000x without reshuffling

t29_objective.name: L_fork
t29_objective.formula: relu(M - logit(gold_fork_token) + max logit(prefix-compatible competitor tokens)) at the single unique-commit index
t29_objective.implementation: same teacher-forced answer forward as CE; no generated-prefix rollout; no extra model forward
t29_objective.fork_detection_rule: TRAIN identities only (T3 audits.train_names, 16 names). Fire only if another TRAIN identity shares a nonempty token prefix under frozen v0_7 inventory sequences. fork_index is the first k where |share gold[:k]|>=2 and |share gold[:k+1]|==1. Unique-first-token names have no fork; do not invent one. DEV names and DEV fail-modes are not used to build the rule.
t29_objective.competitor_token_rule: At fork_index, the distinct next tokens of TRAIN identities that share gold[:k] but differ at k. Not full-vocab hard negatives.

study_rule: HARD_STOP if any; >=2 FULL_SUCCESS => FULL_SUCCESS; >=2 of FULL or REPRESENTATION_SUCCESS_OUTPUT_FAIL => REPRESENTATION_SUCCESS_OUTPUT_FAIL; else FAIL_NO_REPRESENTATION. Do not lower the 2/3 bar. Do not cherry-pick one seed. Do not retune lambda/margin after seeing seeds.
success_logic_descriptive: Interesting only if first-disambiguating-token accuracy rises, shared-prefix exact rises above T28 4.7%, first-token-correct-then-diverge falls, overall exact beats T18/T24/T28 ceiling, unique-prefix does not regress materially, language and representation hold, and the pattern replicates. Native greedy only. Forced-choice or single-family improvement is not success.
eval_metrics_added: first_disambiguating_token_accuracy on DEV identity forks (same rule, DEV inventory, evaluation only)
